**1) Product Overview**
Our AI & Robotics Design System combines cutting-edge technology with approachable, playful aesthetics through cartoon-inspired visuals. This design guide ensures consistent, delightful user experiences across all product touchpoints—from mobile apps to physical robot interfaces—making complex AI and robotics concepts feel friendly and accessible to users of all technical backgrounds.

**2) Target Users**
Our primary audiences are tech-curious individuals aged 8–65, including students learning robotics, educators integrating AI into classrooms, enterprise teams adopting automation, and families exploring smart home technology. Secondary users include developers and designers who need quick reference standards for maintaining visual consistency across platforms.

**3) Color Palette**
Electric Blue (#0066FF) serves as our primary action color, conveying innovation and trust; Coral Orange (#FF6B4A) adds warmth and approachability; Mint Green (#2DD4BF) represents growth and sustainability; and Soft Charcoal (#2D3748) grounds the palette with readability and stability for text and backgrounds.

**4) Typography**
Use Fredoka One as the heading font—its round, geometric letterforms reinforce our cartoon aesthetic while maintaining clarity at any size. Pair it with Inter for body text, whose clean, neutral design ensures excellent readability in dense technical documentation while complementing Fredoka's playfulness.

**5) Cartoon Mascot Description**
Our mascot, "Bolt," is a curious, rounded robot with large expressive eyes, antenna-like sensors, and subtle articulation lines suggesting friendly movement. Bolt's design avoids sharp edges, features our brand colors naturally integrated into its form, and conveys intelligence balanced with approachability—equally at home in an enterprise dashboard or a children's learning app.

**6) Three Core Design Principles**
**Clarity Through Simplification:** Strip unnecessary complexity from interfaces; every visual element should communicate one clear idea. **Personality in Motion:** Use micro-animations and subtle cartoon physics to make interactions feel alive without distraction. **Inclusive Accessibility:** Ensure sufficient contrast, legible type sizes, and intuitive layouts so users of all abilities enjoy the playful aesthetic without barriers.
